pairs.hanzi: 塔维收好，又把鹭汀的信说了一遍：他已回信，还没有回音。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhī wèn yào buyào bǎ shōuxìn chù jì gěi tā ,
pairs.english: Nerai only asked whether he'd like to give her the receiving address,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾只问要不要把收信处记给她，

pairs.target: wànyī yǐhòu zhēn yǒu jīhuì jīngguò , yě zhīdào gāi zhǎo shuí wèn .
pairs.english: so if she ever did pass that way, she'd know whom to ask.
pairs.hanzi: 万一以后真有机会经过，也知道该找谁问。

pairs.target: tā shuō yào , dàn búyào tì tā dāying shénme , tā biàn bǎ míngzì hé qùchù zhàochāo xiàlái .
pairs.english: He said yes, but not to promise anything on his behalf; she copied down the names and destination as given.
pairs.hanzi: 他说要，但不要替他答应什么，她便把名字和去处照抄下来。

pairs.target: huíwū de lùshang , tǎ wéi qǔ dào le sè lātuō bó yà xiě lái de duǎnxìn .
pairs.english: On his way back to his room, Tavi collected a short letter Sela had asked Boya to write.
pairs.hanzi: 回屋的路上，塔维取到了瑟拉托博娅写来的短信。

pairs.target: tā kànguò xuégōng jì qù de shuōmíng , réng yǒu jǐjù kànbùdǒng , děng tā huíjiā zài wèn .
pairs.english: She'd read the academy's explanation, though some lines were still unclear; she'd ask when he came home.
pairs.hanzi: 她看过学宫寄去的说明，仍有几句看不懂，等他回家再问。

pairs.target: mòwěi shuō ā duō yòu bǎ yāodài diàn hòu le yìdiǎn , nà zhǎndēng zhào lù hái xíng ;
pairs.english: At the end she said Ado had padded the belt a little more, and the lamp still lit his path well enough;
pairs.hanzi: 末尾说阿多又把腰带垫厚了一点，那盏灯照路还行；

pairs.target: guōgài de niǔ dǎo sōng le , tā xià huílái ruò yǒukōng , tì jiālǐ kànkàn .
pairs.english: but the pot-lid knob had worked loose. Next time he came, if he had time, could he take a look for home?
pairs.hanzi: 锅盖的钮倒松了，他下回来若有空，替家里看看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò dào chuāng biān , bǎ hé tú de rìqī hé huíjiā de niàntou fēnkāi jìxià .
pairs.english: Tavi sat by the window, noting the chart-checking dates separately from his thought of going home.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐到窗边，把核图的日期和回家的念头分开记下。

pairs.target: lóuxià yǒurén hǎn wǎnfàn , tā yìng le , què xiān bǎ sè lā nà zhāng zhǐ zhé hǎo , jiá zài zuì cháng fānkāi de nà yíyè lǐ .
pairs.english: Someone downstairs called supper. He answered, but first folded Sela's letter and slipped it into the page he opened most often.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下有人喊晚饭，他应了，却先把瑟拉那张纸折好，夹在最常翻开的那一页里。
